description: The vibestreak leaderboard of AI-assisted developers, ranked by consistency (active days), commits shipped with an AI co-author, current streak, or tokens. Optionally a date range, one or more AI tools, or only GitHub-verified profiles. Use `you` to include a particular person's rank.

from.description: Start of a custom range (YYYY-MM-DD); needs `to`; replaces period.

period.description: The window: today, the last 7/30/90 days in each person's own timezone, or all time. Default 30d.

tool.description: Only this AI coding tool (claude = Claude Code). Default: all tools.

tools.description: Several AI tools at once: a day counts if any of them was used. Default: all tools.

verified.description: Only profiles whose shipped days GitHub's public calendars back up.

you.description: A handle whose row to include wherever it ranks.

name: get_leaderboard
title: vibestreak leaderboard
